answer_1.quote: We contribute the Impressions dataset, a multimodal benchmark that consists of 4,320 unique annotations over 1,440 image-caption pairs... Each annotation explores (1) the aesthetic impactfulness of a photograph, (2) image descriptions... (3) emotions/thoughts/beliefs... (4) the aesthetic elements that elicited the expressed impression.
answer_1.outputs: Free-form captions for image description, perception (impression), and aesthetic evaluation.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation Table displays the BLEU, METEOR, and ROUGE scores for each of these models.

answer_4.quote: We submitted the 300 generation pairs to UpWork and requested that annotators identify which caption better simulates a potential human impression and identifies impactful aesthetic elements.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to select which caption better simulates a potential human impression and identifies impactful aesthetic elements.
